title: Get Procedural 3D Working End to End
description: Get procedural 3d working end to end. Currently the canvas shows after a second an error: Render error: session.clearGhostWidget is not a function
summary: Fixed procedural 3d end-to-end Render error session.clearGhostWidget is not a function. Root cause: broken FE0E/FE0F node_modules symlinks + nested /pkg/ imports made Vite serve a FlowSession stub missing clearGhostWidget. Repaired symlinks, pointed flow-core workspace at wasm-pack pkg output, switched engine imports to package mains, made wasm stub resolver return resolved absolute paths and stub ghost APIs, fixed Rust char-literal VS pollution and TokenKind/Shape exhaustiveness blocking wasm builds. Verified on :6018: title semio · procedural · 3d, Flow+Preview, 3 canvases, no render/ghost errors.
